title.narrative: Socremo TA: Consultancy on TA Design and its Monitoring & Evaluation
Socremo TA: Consultancy on TA Design and its Monitoring & Evaluation

description.narrative:
As a part of the appraisal process of the Socremo guarantee in 2014 the Embassy concluded that aditional efforts were needed regarding monitoring and evaluation of the results of the guarantee, and additional capacity was needed – for both Socremo and the new borrowers – to increase the likelihood for results fulfilment and sustainability of results post-guarantee.
Thus the main objective of this consultancy is to develop: 1) TA package that will build capacity in specified areas important for the borrowers to be able to become more bankable post-guarantee and identified capacity needs at Socremo/staff, for instance in the development of new financial products that are tailored for the new segment. and 2) M&E system that monitors the results that the guarantee aims to fulfil in order increase the likelihood for results achievement and sustainability of results post-guarantee.
Direkt upphandling användes i vilket den har begärts Express Intresse från minst 5 tjänsteleverantörer.

This was a consultant work to advise the Embassy of Sweden on the options of business training to be provided to women entrepreneurs under the Loan Portfolio Guarantee between the Sida and USAID with SOCREMO microfinance bank. The deliverables wer a final consolidated report on technical assitance to guarantee beneficiaries with two annexes detailing the training provision and the set up of monitoring and evaluation. All the reports were provided. The work was performed by a boutique consultant company named AYANI from the Netherlands.
